question: The compound interest compounded annually on a sum of money for 2 years is ₹1,128.6 and the simple interest on the same sum for the same period is ₹1,080. What is the difference between the compound interest compounded annually and the simple interest for 3 years?
solution:
(Formula Used:

**1**. SI = P × R× Tover100

For CI

**2**. A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

**3**. CI = A - P

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time, A = Amount

**4**. Effective rate = r1 + r2 + r₁ × r₂ over 100

Where “r1” and “r2” are rates of interest during successive years

**Concept Used:**

SI and CI for the first year is the same. The difference in the CI and SI for 2 years is due to the compounding part of the interest for the first year.

Calculation:

According to the question

SI for 2 years = ₹ 1,080

⇒ SI for 1 year = ₹ 1,080 ÷ 2 = ₹ 540

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

⇒ ₹1,128.6 - ₹1,080 = ₹48.6

Using SI formula

⇒ R = 48.6× 100over540× 1 = 9%

Calculating principal using the SI formula

⇒ P = 1080× 100over9× 2 = ₹ 6000

Effective compound interest rate for 2 years

⇒ 9 + 9 +9 × 9over100 = 18.81%

Effective compound interest rate for 3 years

⇒ 18.81 + 9 + 18.81 × 9over100 = 27.81 + 1.6929 = 29.5029%

Effective simple interest rate for 3 years = 3 × 9 = 27%

Since the difference in the interest would be due to the difference in the rate component

⇒ Difference in the interest rate = 29.5029% - 27% = 2.5029%

⇒ Difference in the interest at 2.5029% = 6000× 2.5029× 1over100 = ₹150.174

**∴ The difference in the interest is ₹ 150.174.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Formula Used:

For 2 years, CI - SI = P × (R/100)²

For 3 years, CI - SI = P ×** **(R/100)² × (300 + R)/100

**Calculation:**

SI for 2 years = ₹ 1,080

⇒ SI for 1 year = ₹ 1,080 ÷ 2 = ₹ 540

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

⇒ ₹1,128.6 - ₹1,080 = ₹48.6

Using SI formula

⇒ R = 48.6× 100over540× 1 = 9%

Calculating principal using the SI formula

⇒ P = 1080× 100over9× 2 = ₹ 6000

Now, according to the formula for 3 years

CI - SI = 6000 × (9/100)² × (300 + 9)/100

⇒ CI - SI = 6000 × (81/10000) × 309/100

⇒ CI - SI = 150.174

**∴ The correct answer is option 3**
